testing_progress.highlight: DevNet blocked by slow key loading; compact key loading (PR #802) needed before scaling past ~64 validators
Nimbus still on old spec (2^20 leaves); Lighthouse and Lodestar working; Prysm in progress; Teku (Paul) not yet interoping; Ethlambda targeting pq-devnet-0 by end of day
Single-client local runs confirmed: Lighthouse+Lodestar interop working with few validators; no aggregation observed yet at 1,000 validators

networking_p2p.highlight: gossip-sub insufficient for PQ aggregates: simulations show 200–300 Mbps bandwidth spikes, 7× more bandwidth than announce-and-pull
Anton's simulation (800K validators, 16 subnets, 2 aggregators/subnet, D=4 gossip-sub): tester nodes at capacity, P99 aggregates arrive at 11.7s; local block builder P99 at 8s
Path forward: Waggle + seacast (segmented broadcast); Lighthouse has 8411 Waggle implementation; Prysm seacast-on-Waggle in progress; seacast-rs (Rust) also WIP
Cross-checking simulations requested before drawing conclusions; Csaba's single-message zcast results show factor 2–3 bandwidth reduction vs gossip-sub

aggregation_benchmarks.highlight: LeanVM aggregation on NUC 14 Pro: 3.5s baseline; ~2s achievable with 6 performance cores allocated to LeanVM (EL running alongside)
Expected ~1,500 XMSS signatures/subnet at 800K validators / 16 committees; staggered aggregation (500ms apart) proposed and tentatively accepted

pq_migration_and_credentials.highlight: XMSS signature verification added to PQ registration system contract (EIP updated by Justin + Ignacio); contract live at pq-staking-contracts repo
Proposal: disallow new 0x00 and 0x01 validator deposits at H-star fork; requires EIP-8148 (effective balance cap) as dependency; no ETH burning — inactive state instead
Best-case consolidation from 0x02-only: validator set could drop from 800K to ~54K (or under 100K), potentially eliminating recursive aggregation
0x00 validators who forgot to migrate: proposal to move funds to EL contract recoverable by original depositor address; no consensus reached, deferred async

spec_open_questions.highlight: Syncing: assume genesis-only start for current DevNet phase; checkpoint sync deferred
Beacon API PQ branch needed; Manu volunteered to own ERCs for VRF tree spec and ERC-2333/2334/2335 analogues

organizational.highlight: Tuesday call preferred over Friday; 3 weekly calls to continue while aggregation and P2P questions remain open; Justin OOO all next week (Thanksgiving), Kev moderating

decisions.decision: Adopt PR #802 (Emil's compact key loading) as the approach for XMSS key loading optimization; clients to implement
DevNet nodes will start from genesis only; syncing support deferred to a later phase
First DevNet will use gossip-sub as baseline; Waggle + seacast devnet to follow once at least one client has segmented broadcast ready (targeting ~next week for Lighthouse)
Disallowing new 0x01 deposits at H-star depends on EIP-8148 being included; discussion on mechanism (inactive state vs burn) deferred async
